name: NetSpy
description: Web dashboard showing real-time network + disk monitoring of Unraid (and other hosts): interface rates, per-process breakdown (incl. SMB sessions per client), per-container traffic, disk I/O per process, CPU/RAM per process, latency/health, storage fill-level history and SSH web terminals. One image, two roles — this template installs the web role; add agents on other hosts (TrueNAS/Debian) via the repo's docker-compose.yml.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Mount the Docker socket (read-only) so container names appear in the process list (per-container throughput).

paths.name: Config Volume
paths.description: Base directory for the settings page — servers.yaml is stored in the /netspy/config subfolder (created automatically). After install, make it world-writable on the host: chmod 777 /mnt/user/appdata/netspy (container runs as root with cap_drop ALL and needs write access).

variables.name: ROLE
variables.description: Role: web = dashboard + local sampler (this host); agent = collector for another web instance.

variables.name: SERVERS
variables.description: Servers the dashboard polls, semicolon-separated: Name=local;Name=http://host:8091. 'local' samples this host directly; http://... polls an agent on another host. Once the config volume is mounted and servers.yaml exists there, that file wins over this variable.

variables.name: UPLINK
variables.description: Optional override of the uplink interfaces (comma-separated, e.g. br0,bond0). Empty = auto-detect via default route (br0 on Unraid).

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone inside the container, e.g. Europe/Berlin. It sets the day and month boundary of the storage history (daily/monthly fill level is fixed at local midnight instead of 02:00 with UTC) and all timestamps. Empty = UTC.

variables.name: PORT:8090
variables.description: Host port of the web UI. Host networking: the value IS the host port.

variables.name: PORT:8091
variables.description: Host port of the agent API (used by other hosts' dashboards to poll this one). Host networking: the value IS the host port.

variables.name: AGENT_TOKEN
variables.description: Shared token for agent API access — must be identical on the web instance and every agent (set a long random value).

variables.name: TTYD_USER
variables.description: SSH terminal tab login: username. The Terminal tab stays locked until both TTYD_USER and TTYD_PASS are set (the rest of the dashboard stays open). Leave both empty to disable the terminals.

variables.name: TTYD_PASS
variables.description: SSH terminal tab login: password (with TTYD_USER). Never stored — only compared against the credentials you type in the login form.

variables.name: DOCKER_SOCK
variables.description: Docker socket path for per-container rows. Keep the 'Docker Socket' path mapping below active; set to empty to disable.

variables.name: CONFIG_DIR
variables.description: Advanced: folder inside the container that holds servers.yaml. Empty = auto-detect (/netspy/config when the Config Volume above is mounted to /netspy). Only change it if you mount your config somewhere else.
